name: Spiti

source.name: Kunzum Range glaciers, near Kunzum Pass

sink.name: Confluence with the Sutlej at Khab Sangam
sink.location: Khab, Kinnaur district, Himachal Pradesh, India

did_you_know: The Spiti Valley — carved by this river — is a cold desert, receiving so little of the monsoon that it's often called "Little Tibet."
The Spiti meets the much larger, glacier-grey Sutlej at Khab Sangam, where the two rivers run visibly different colours before merging.
